Filesystem and path utilities: - File: src/utils/storyReferenceUtils.ts - Top-level JSDoc: - @story docs/stories/006.0-DEV-FILE-VALIDATION.story.md - @req REQ-PATH-RESOLUTION, REQ-FILE-EXISTENCE, REQ-SECURITY-VALIDATION, REQ-ERROR-HANDLING, REQ-PERFORMANCE-OPTIMIZATION. - Caching and existence checks (REQ-FILE-EXISTENCE, REQ-PERFORMANCE-OPTIMIZATION, REQ-ERROR-HANDLING): - fileExistStatusCache: Map caches filesystem checks. - checkSingleCandidate(candidate): - Uses cache first. - Wraps fs.existsSync and fs.statSync in try/catch. - Returns status "exists" for regular files, "missing" otherwise. - On any fs error, returns status "fs-error" with captured error but never throws. - getStoryExistence(candidates): - Iterates candidates via checkSingleCandidate. - Immediately returns status "exists" with matchedPath on first success. - If no exists but at least one fs-error, returns status "fs-error" with representative error. - Otherwise returns status "missing". - storyExists(paths: string[]): returns true iff getStoryExistence(...).status === "exists". - __resetStoryExistenceCacheForTests(): clears fileExistStatusCache for clean test runs. - Path resolution (REQ-PATH-RESOLUTION, REQ-CONFIGURABLE-PATHS): - buildStoryCandidates(storyPath, cwd, storyDirs): - If storyPath starts with "./" or "../": candidates = [path.resolve(cwd, storyPath)]. - Else: candidates = [path.resolve(cwd, storyPath)] plus, for each dir in storyDirs, path.resolve(cwd, dir, path.basename(storyPath)). - normalizeStoryPath(storyPath, cwd, storyDirs): returns { candidates, exists, existence } based on buildStoryCandidates + getStoryExistence. - Project boundary (REQ-PROJECT-BOUNDARY): - enforceProjectBoundary(candidate, cwd): - Resolves both to absolute paths. - isWithinProject is true only when candidate === cwd or startsWith(cwd + path.sep). - Security helpers (REQ-SECURITY-VALIDATION): - isAbsolutePath, containsPathTraversal, isTraversalUnsafe, hasValidExtension, isUnsafeStoryPath implement absolute/traversal/extension checks.

traceability.notes: The story 006.0-DEV-FILE-VALIDATION is fully implemented. The `traceability/valid-story-reference` rule, together with `storyReferenceUtils`, validates that `@story` annotations reference existing `.story.md` files, enforces project boundaries and security checks (no unintended path traversal or absolute paths by default), and supports configurable story directories and extension requirements. Filesystem access is handled safely with caching and non-throwing status objects, and clear diagnostics (fileMissing, invalidExtension, invalidPath, fileAccessError) give precise feedback about missing files, invalid extensions, unsafe paths, and filesystem errors. Comprehensive tests in `tests/rules/valid-story-reference.test.ts` cover core functionality, configuration options, boundary and security behavior, and error handling scenarios, all traced back to this story. Documentation in `docs/rules/valid-story-reference.md` describes behavior, configuration, and examples consistent with the story’s acceptance criteria and requirements. Based on code, tests, and documentation, all listed acceptance criteria and requirements for this story are satisfied.
